steps.text: The cities had been quiet for months. Streets were cracked, and wind moved through empty windows.
Deep underground, the last mission control was a concrete bunker lit by old screens.
Everyone who is left is in this room.
Atleast that's what we know for now. There could be more living out there!
Oh, come on! You don' really think that someoune could really survive that!
The radiation levels are so high not even cockroaches are moving.
Let's keep being optimistic. With this attitude, we'll get nowhere.
Then we work together. Nobody builds a rocket alone.
Out there are machines built to survive cold, dust and radiation. Just like Earth now.
The landers and rovers ZENTRA left on the Moon and Mars, decades ago.
We bring their parts home, take them apart and learn exactly how they were built.
Reverse engineering. Then we build something new: a rover that can drive through the radiation up here.
And search for anyone else who is still alive.
They shook hands. On the wall, the old ZENTRA sign got a fresh coat of paint.
